identityPolicy: Exact existing stellar component identifiers and ATNF PSRJ names. No coordinate matching. Some recently catalogued pulsars have no SIMBAD record; use their frozen ATNF identifiers. Nebula aliases resolving to illuminating stars or galaxy clusters are withheld. Gaia compact-object aliases identify the plotted unresolved system.

extensions.note: Second extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 1 of the 2000-ly census; earlier rows are unchanged.
Third extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 2; vdB numbers are omitted because SIMBAD attaches them to the illuminating stars. Earlier rows are unchanged.
Fourth extended.adql query appended for nebula batch 3; vdB, vdBH, DG 174 and LBN 472 identifiers are omitted because SIMBAD attaches them to the illuminating stars. Earlier rows are unchanged.
